info.title: MLBB Historical Database API
info.description:
Open REST API over the MLBB (Mobile Legends: Bang Bang) historical database 2016-2026: patches, hero/item balance history, M-Series world championships, esports events, game systems, client/collabs and business records. Exactly 78 endpoints, all read-only.

Source repo: https://github.com/ryujin-hue/mlbb-historical-database

get.summary: Events by calendar year (MPL rows use seasons)
Records for one system (Map, Ranking, Emblem, ...)
Generic access to any reference table
